name: Image generation
description: Make pictures with the local stable-diffusion.cpp (the same one as the Generate window), from a prompt you keep in a text file so it can be edited and versioned. Every image gets a .prompt.json next to it (prompt, preset, steps, SEED, size, model): the record that lets you make the same picture again or change one thing. Sizes are capped at 512 per side (a 4 GB GPU runs out of memory above that) and Ollama's models are released from the GPU first. Extra arguments: steps=20 seed=N size=512x512 negative="blurry, text". Make an image, a logo, an icon or a favicon; Variants makes 2 to 6 seeds of the same prompt as one contact sheet (count=4); Check says whether everything is installed. The prompt is read as text and the program is started without a shell, so nothing in a prompt can run. Pictures that need judging (does it match the prompt?) go to the Vision tool: Describe.

presets.label: Make an image from the prompt file
presets.description: The input is a text file holding the prompt. Extra: steps=, seed=, size=, negative=.

presets.label: Logo (flat, centered, dark background)
presets.description: Adds a flat vector logo style to your prompt.

presets.label: App icon (flat, simple)
presets.description: Adds an app-icon style to your prompt.

presets.label: Favicon (tiny, simple)
presets.description: A tiny single-subject icon; scale it down with the Image tools.

presets.label: Variants: 2 to 6 seeds as one sheet
presets.description: count=4 by default; each image keeps its own seed in the record.

presets.label: Check: is it installed, which model, how much room
presets.description: Reads nothing from the input; just reports.
